report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: lateral dislocation of left patella
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is currently anatomic. Acute osseous contusions at the inferomedial patella and anterior lateral femoral condyle, consistent with a recent transient lateral patellar dislocation. Background marrow signal is otherwise normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small-to-moderate joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Focal full-thickness chondral fissuring along the lateral facet with underlying subchondral edema.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal. 
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Complete rupture of the medial patellofemoral ligament at the femoral attachment site. High-grade tearing of the medial patellar retinaculum at the patellar attachment with possible thin avulsed cortical fragment (series 6 image 6).
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 8 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. Poststenotic soft tissue edema along the anterior medial femoral condyle.

IMPRESSION:
Findings of recent transient lateral patellar dislocation with osseous contusions of the medial patellar facet and lateral femoral condyle, focal full-thickness cartilage fissuring along the lateral facet, high-grade injury of the medial constraints, and associated joint effusion.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Rodilla traumática aguda.
Hallazgos:
Ligamentos cruzados y colateral lateral sin alteraciones.
Leve engrosamiento y aumento de señal del componente superficial del ligamento colateral medial
con pérdida parcial de continuidad en su inserción femoral. No se observa aumento de señal con
pérdida parcial de la continuidad de la inserción femoral del ligamento menisco femoral profundo
del complejo medial con leve cantidad de líquido entre los componentes.
Edema óseo con fractura subcortical del aspecto anterior y periférico del platillo tibial lateral con
mínimo hundimiento, sin desplazamiento de segmentos.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y patelofemoral sin alteraciones.
Leve a moderada lipohemartrosis. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos. Distensión con líquido
rodeando los tendones de la pata de ganso en su inserción distal.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Signos de un esguince grado II del tercio proximal del componente superficial y profundo del
complejo ligamentario medial con edema las partes blandas regionales.
Edema óseo con fractura subcortical del aspecto anterior y periférico del platillo tibial lateral con
mínimo hundimiento, sin desplazamiento de segmentos.
Leve a moderada lipohemartrosis.
Distensión con líquido de ambos tendones de la pata de ganso en su inserción distal,
probablemente de manera reactiva
